title: Verdict
description: The machine-readable verdict: what the backend answers to a declaration or a check. Over hook routes it is rendered as text inside additionalContext (hook-response.json); richer transports (MCP tools, APIs) MAY expose this JSON shape directly. RULE: no verdict without a named neighbour, a cited path, a reason and a course of action.

kind.description: free: go ahead (a neighbour may still be named, D0). caution: read the neighbour worksite before editing (D1/D2). wait: work outside the zone or take another ticket (D3/D4). stop: hard mode, zone reserved or frozen — do not touch.

collisions.description: One entry per collision. Empty when kind is 'free' with no neighbour.

pendingNotices.description: Notices delivered with this response — once per session, never twice.

text.description: Human/agent-readable rendering of the whole verdict (the text injected as additionalContext over hook routes).

freezeSuggestion.description: Suggested announced freeze when a declaration is huge, instead of hundreds of collisions.

collisionId.description: Stable id, used to resolve the collision (wait/sequence/coordinate/split/merge/override). OPTIONAL in a minimum server.

degree.description: Collision degree after modulation: D0 same zone different files, D1 same folder, D2 same file, D3 same file with delete/move/rename on one side, D4 exclusive/reserved/frozen, D5 broken contract.

rawDegree.description: Degree before modulation (hotspot −1, dormant neighbour −1, prediction-only capped at D1).

reason.description: Why this collides, e.g. 'same file touched by two worksites'. REQUIRED.

advice.description: What to do instead, e.g. 'read the neighbour worksite before editing this file'. REQUIRED.

estimatedResumeMinutes.description: Estimated time until the zone frees up (wait/stop verdicts).

sameTicket.description: Two sessions on the same ticket.

samePilot.description: Both worksites are driven by the same pilot. No degree discount — only alert routing changes.

probable.description: A prediction-only side is involved: degree capped at D1, information labelled 'probable'.

hardDeny.description: Hard mode would deny edits here.

neighbor.description: The other worksite. REQUIRED: issueKey, actorLabel, state.

issueKey.description: Ticket key, e.g. PROJ-88. A worksite without a ticket MAY use a backend-specific label; the field stays REQUIRED.

prApproved.description: When true the verdict SHOULD advise waiting for the merge — it is close.

notice.description: Latest notice posted by that worksite, if any.
